propositions: When git merge aborts with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge', reconverge cannot advance and leaves local commits orphaned off origin
Tracked working-tree deletions (especially staged deletions from interrupted compact_txn folds) and tracked working-tree modifications block merge and must be recovered non-destructively
Worktree deletions of tracked files are restored via git checkout, and worktree modifications are quarantined byte-for-byte before restore, then the merge is retried once
Genuine merge conflicts (different content on both sides) still abort, keep local, and hint fsck-recover without attempting recovery
The recovery mechanism reuses the parsing and seam from variant (a) untracked-file handling, extending _merge_abort_named_paths to detect and act on porcelain status codes
